note: SystemRelativeTime of WGC frames is ~10-12 ms LATER than the callback arrival on this machine, i.e. it behaves like the composition's target vblank, not a render-complete time, so source-based latencies are negative and not used for verdicts. Present return is not photon time: DWM shows the frame at a later vblank (one more refresh period is a reasonable estimate). drawToGpuDone is measured by waiting on an event query right after the draw.
